title: Bound chart-207 terminal helper retargets
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**NO VERIFIED GAIN.** The comparator is independently reproduced #7334 at `aaeec8c0acf01e99a5f331ef363a698d9c084ace` with signed #7113 at `07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d`.

Two literal walks cover all 615 scoped public 3→127 targets and find exactly six final 207→127 rank-one MOVEs. The separately protected role 319 ends via 1089→127. Each eligible helper has a later binary contact with an exterior partner. Across the six anchors there are 203 exterior binary contacts and zero internal contacts. Every simultaneous fixed-clock subset therefore fails.

Two suffixes have exactly two later ADDs. The commuting-retime screen exhausts 5,084 typed cuts, and the independent walk confirms that none of the four original partners ever occupies chart 207. For role 532 we also grant arbitrary unchanged public donors across its entire final read-free chart-207 corridor. The exact covector `x2 − x3/2 − x27 + x28` vanishes at all 13,732 donor placements across 1,406 cuts and evaluates to +1 on the 23-coordinate signed aggregate. All tested scopes are exhausted.

The hypothetical single retarget deletes 17 paid rank-one positions and retypes 17 productive rank-nine targets to rank eight. The six actual anchors give an optimistic combined upper of 1.161771723173607 raw, rounded upward. No realized saving.

## Task and overlap

#7274 and #7277 supply distinct compensated terminal recharts on earlier words. #7383 and #7384 test the earlier role-532 MOVE triple with fixed productive endpoints. This scope changes the terminal target and leaves the other paid paths fixed. Canonical main was `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57` at pre-submit refresh.

## Validation

Use CPython 3.12 with assertions enabled from a clean checkout.

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/p104-chart207-terminal-retarget-bound/replay.py
```

The Git-free replay reproduces 13 receipts and rejects four altered dependencies. The research commit adds one package on the existing two #7257 CI fixes for the historical replay gap documented in #7371. The selected record is unchanged.

## Credit

#7334 and #7113 supply the exact native word and caller. #7365 and #7362 supply the change inventory and exact rank stock. #7383 and #7384 supply the retime and aggregate engines. #7355 supplies rational row replay, and #7298 the directed tariff. OpenAI Codex and subagents materially assisted.

## Open next questions

Changed owned donors, new paid routes, and corrected noncommuting blocks are outside the tested scopes. Review and merge are left to the maintainers.
